card.statement:
A poset
${\cal P}=\{p_1,\dots,p_t\}$ is a chain if $p_1 \prec p_2 \prec \dots \prec p_t$.
A poset $\cal P$ is a semichain if it has the form

\begin{equation}
\mathcal P_1 \prec \mathcal P_2 \prec \dots \prec \mathcal P_s
\end{equation}

in which every $\mathcal P_i$ consists of one or two incomparable elements and $\mathcal P_i\prec\mathcal P_{i+1}$ means that $a\prec b$ for all $a\in\mathcal P_{i}$ and $b\in\mathcal P_{i+1}$.
card.label: Definition 2

paper.title: Systems of subspaces of a unitary space
paper.abstract: For a given poset, we consider its representations by systems of subspaces of a unitary space ordered by inclusion. We classify such systems for all posets for which an explicit classification is possible.
